About the job

INCORE is hiring a Senior Growth Marketer (SEO, AI Search, Lifecycle & Social): a strategic, analytical marketer who also ships the work.

 

We're a boutique digital agency serving U.S. clients across healthcare, education, manufacturing, and more. Clients rely on us to grow their online presence through strategy, design, development, automation, and digital marketing. You'll shape INCORE's marketing direction and lead client growth across classic search, AI search, lifecycle, and social.

 

Initially, you'll be a one-person powerhouse: shaping frameworks, executing campaigns, building lifecycle journeys, running social, and setting up analytics. As the role grows, you'll build and lead a small team.

 




🧭 How this role is scoped

 

You own marketing and client growth end to end. You're hands-on with SEO and AI search, positioning, analytics, lifecycle in Customer.io, and social. At the start you run social yourself for INCORE and the first client accounts, using AI and scheduling tools to keep it efficient, and hand off execution as volume grows. For heavy server-side tracking builds you direct a specialist. We hire for ownership and judgment, then add hands under you.

 




🥸 Requirements

 

5+ years in SEO, digital marketing, or web growth strategy (agency or B2B preferred).
Deep understanding of technical and content SEO, site architecture, and conversion optimization.
Hands-on growth experience in lead gen and e-commerce: funnel design, lead qualification, CRM handoff, e-commerce tracking (AOV, LTV, ROAS).
Lifecycle marketing, hands-on in Customer.io (or Klaviyo, Braze, HubSpot with fast ramp into Customer.io). Core to the role: you design the strategy (onboarding, nurture, re-engagement, win-back, post-purchase, review/referral) and build it yourself: segments, event-triggered journeys, branching, Liquid personalization, transactional messages, A/B tests, webhooks/API.
Strong working knowledge of AI search visibility across AEO (being the extracted answer in AI Overviews, snippets, voice), GEO (being cited in ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Mode, Copilot, Grok), and AIO (the entity, reputation, and trust signals that make AI systems recommend a brand). You can explain how each differs from classic SEO and what moves them.
Social media, strategy and execution, across LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, X, and YouTube: platform selection by ICP, content pillars, short-form video, social search optimization, and reporting tied to business outcomes. You're comfortable running this yourself at the start (planning, producing, scheduling, posting), using AI for drafting and repurposing and a scheduling tool to keep it efficient, and handing it off as volume grows.
Strong positioning and messaging fluency: defining ICPs, articulating differentiation, shaping messaging for website copy, landing pages, and campaigns.
Strong understanding of end-to-end tracking pipelines: consent layer → client-side GTM → server-side GTM → GA4, ad platforms, CDPs. You specify, QA, and maintain the architecture and are hands-on in GTM/GA4; heavy server-side implementation can go to a specialist under your direction.
Experience with CMPs (OneTrust, Usercentrics, Cookiebot) and Google Consent Mode v2 for GDPR and CCPA/CPRA compliance.
Working knowledge of PPC principles and metrics (oversight, not daily management).
Near-native English fluency: confident communicator comfortable pitching, presenting, and leading client meetings.

 

Hands-on experience with:

SEO: SEMrush or Ahrefs (incl. AI visibility modules), Search Console, Screaming Frog / Sitebulb.
Analytics: GA4, GTM (web + server-side), Looker Studio.
Lifecycle: Customer.io (journeys, segments, data pipelines, transactional).
Social: a scheduling and analytics tool.
AI tools: Fluent daily use of Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini for research, briefs, drafting, editing, synthesizing analytics, and QAing AI output. You know where AI accelerates work, where human judgment is non-negotiable, and how to build voice guides and reusable Projects/Custom GPTs so output reflects the brand.

 




✨ Nice-to-Haves

 

Hands-on server-side GTM implementation (Stape, self-hosted, or similar).
Email deliverability (domain warm-up, DMARC/DKIM/SPF, list hygiene).
Paid social or creator partnerships.

 




⛑️ Responsibilities

 

INCORE Marketing Ownership

Lead INCORE's marketing direction: SEO, AI search, lifecycle, social, conversion, content, and reporting.
Oversee content, landing pages, case studies, and lifecycle flows in Customer.io.
Define and maintain KPIs, dashboards, and reporting frameworks.
Use AI tools to accelerate content, briefs, and analysis, with voice guides and QA loops that keep output credible.

 




Positioning & Messaging

Translate positioning into site hierarchy, service pages, case studies, and sales decks.
Lead positioning engagements for clients: define ICPs, surface differentiators, build messaging frameworks.

Client redesigns launch with strong positioning, SEO, analytics, and conversion frameworks.
Tracking, consent, and attribution are correct across every client. No data gaps, no compliance risks.
Every client with a lifecycle need has journeys running in Customer.io that are measured and improved.

Are proactive, accountable, and communicate simply and directly.
Get the most out of AI tools: neither afraid of AI nor blindly reliant on it.

 




⛔️ Do not apply unless you meet ALL 3 criteria below:

 

INCORE is a fully remote team, but to apply, you must:

 

Have near-native English fluency in speaking and writing ("rusty" is not acceptable).
Be located within a 6-hour time window of the Eastern Time zone (UTC-5/-4).
Be reliably available during core collaboration hours (8 AM – 3 PM ET), within our overall 8 AM – 5 PM ET business hours. Flexibility outside core hours is fine.

description:
About the job

SOLO MÉXICO 




CADICZA busca incorporar estudiantes de Marketing, Mercadotecnia, Publicidad, Comunicación, Branding o áreas afines para realizar PRACTICAS PROFESIONALES O SERVICIO SOCIAL dentro de nuestro equipo.




Buscamos estudiantes a partir de 7.º semestre de licenciatura cursada en México, con interés en desarrollarse dentro de un entorno empresarial real y participar en proyectos de construcción de marca, comunicación y desarrollo de negocios.




PERFIL




Buscamos personas con interés o habilidades en:




• Branding e identidad de marca

• Creación y planeación de campañas

• Desarrollo de contenido para redes sociales

• Edición de imagen y video

• Comunicación y estrategia digital

• Investigación de mercado y tendencias

• Creatividad y criterio visual

• Organización y trabajo autónomo




No es indispensable dominar todas las áreas. Valoramos principalmente la iniciativa, responsabilidad, criterio y disposición para aprender.




¿QUÉ HARÁS?




Participarás en proyectos reales de CADICZA y sus distintas unidades de negocio, colaborando en actividades como:




• Desarrollo de campañas y estrategias de comunicación

• Creación y edición de contenido

• Apoyo en branding y posicionamiento

• Planeación de contenido para redes sociales

• Investigación de mercados, tendencias y referentes

• Desarrollo de propuestas de marketing

• Apoyo en proyectos especiales de desarrollo de negocios




MODALIDAD




100% online | México




• Horarios flexibles

• El estudiante puede elegir y organizar su horario de colaboración

• Trabajo por objetivos y proyectos

• Participación en el flujo real de una empresa

• Acompañamiento y seguimiento durante el periodo formativo




BENEFICIOS FORMATIVOS




Como parte de nuestra propuesta de formación, ofrecemos:




• Capacitación periódica en temas relacionados con marketing, negocios y desarrollo profesional

title: Senior Manager, Field Marketing
skills: Partner with Global Marketing leadership and regional marketing teams to translate company priorities and business needs into actionable regional and field marketing strategies that drive demand, member acquisition, retention, and revenue.

Identify priority properties and markets where focused marketing investment can have the greatest business impact, informed by customer insights, competitive dynamics, sales needs, property performance, and broader market conditions.
Support the development of localized campaigns, activations, partnerships, events, and other programs designed to generate awareness and demand for specific properties or portfolios.

Partner across Global Marketing channels—including Email, Social, Content/Editorial, Communications, Events, Partnerships, and Paid—to ensure regional and property-level needs are reflected in global programs and campaigns.

Support integrated marketing programs across the full customer journey, from awareness and consideration through lead generation and conversion.

Ensure field marketing programs have clear objectives, target audiences, measurement plans, and connections to commercial outcomes.
Bachelors Degree in Marketing or related
10+ years of marketing experience, with a strong background in regional, field, integrated, or growth marketing within a global or multi-market organization.
Demonstrated experience translating global marketing strategies into effective regional and local execution, balancing consistency with local market needs.
Strong understanding of marketing performance and measurement, with the ability to identify business drivers, interpret data, and translate insights into actionable recommendations.
Strong commercial orientation, with an understanding of how marketing contributes to demand, pipeline, occupancy, revenue, and other business outcomes.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information and clearly communicate recommendations to senior stakeholders.

description:
About the job

About Us

At WeWork, we provide flexible workspace solutions to help businesses of all sizes thrive in more than 37 countries worldwide. The future of work is here, and we’re not just a part of that movement—we’re leading it. United by a desire to build a global community, our purpose is to give members the support to do their best work, and the space to take their ideas to new heights. Join us as we empower tomorrow’s world at work.

About The Role

WeWork is looking for a strategic, analytical, and highly collaborative Senior Manager, Global Field Marketing to help drive marketing performance across our global portfolio. Based in Mexico City and part of WeWork’s Global Marketing team, this role will sit at the intersection of global marketing strategy, regional marketing, and property-level execution, helping ensure our marketing efforts translate into measurable business impact across markets.

The Senior Manager, Global Field Marketing will partner closely with regional marketing leaders and cross-functional teams to develop and evolve the frameworks, programs, and insights that enable strong field marketing around the world. A critical part of the role will be developing a deep understanding of global and regional marketing performance—identifying trends, opportunities, and areas of underperformance and translating those insights into actionable recommendations for regional teams and the broader Global Marketing organization.

This individual will also help strengthen our approach to property marketing, ensuring marketing strategies reflect the needs of individual buildings, neighborhoods, and markets while remaining connected to broader regional and global priorities. The role requires someone who can move fluidly between strategy and execution, understand both portfolio-level and property-level business needs, and bring structure and consistency to marketing across a complex, global organization.

Success in this role will require strong commercial instincts, analytical rigor, and the ability to influence across markets and functions without always having direct ownership of execution.

Global & Regional Marketing Strategy


Partner with Global Marketing leadership and regional marketing teams to translate company priorities and business needs into actionable regional and field marketing strategies that drive demand, member acquisition, retention, and revenue.
Establish a consistent global approach to field marketing while allowing for the flexibility required to address local market dynamics, customer needs, and commercial priorities.
Build strong partnerships across Marketing, Sales, Revenue, Real Estate, Community, Operations, and other key stakeholders to ensure marketing strategies are grounded in business priorities.
Connect insights and best practices across regions, identifying opportunities to scale successful programs, campaigns, and approaches globally.
Support annual and quarterly marketing planning, helping regional teams prioritize initiatives and investments based on business opportunity and expected impact.
Lead and develop a high-performing team while providing guidance and mentorship across the broader regional marketing organization.


Marketing Performance & Business Insights


Develop a comprehensive understanding of global and regional marketing performance, including the key drivers of performance across markets, channels, audiences, and properties.
Partner with regional teams and Global Marketing to define and monitor key performance indicators and build consistent reporting that provides visibility into marketing performance at the global, regional, market, and property levels.
Analyze marketing and business performance to identify trends, opportunities, risks, and the "why" behind performance, combining quantitative data with local market context to develop actionable recommendations.
Translate performance insights into clear narratives and recommendations for Global Marketing leadership, regional teams, and senior cross-functional stakeholders.
Partner with Finance and regional stakeholders to evaluate marketing investment, effectiveness, and ROI and help direct resources toward the highest-impact opportunities.


Regional & Property Marketing


Partner with regional Marketing, Sales, Real Estate, Design, and Operations teams to develop strategies that address market- and property-specific business needs, including new openings, occupancy opportunities, competitive pressures, product priorities, and other commercial objectives.
Evolve WeWork’s global approach to property marketing, creating scalable frameworks, playbooks, and best practices that regional teams can adapt to individual markets and buildings.
Identify priority properties and markets where focused marketing investment can have the greatest business impact, informed by customer insights, competitive dynamics, sales needs, property performance, and broader market conditions.
Support the development of localized campaigns, activations, partnerships, events, and other programs designed to generate awareness and demand for specific properties or portfolios.


Demand Generation & Integrated Marketing


Partner across Global Marketing channels—including Email, Social, Content/Editorial, Communications, Events, Partnerships, and Paid—to ensure regional and property-level needs are reflected in global programs and campaigns.
Help regional teams effectively leverage and localize global campaigns, messaging, creative assets, and channels while identifying where market-specific programs are required.
Support integrated marketing programs across the full customer journey, from awareness and consideration through lead generation and conversion.
Partner with digital and growth teams to identify opportunities to improve local paid media, SEO, web conversion, CRM, and other demand-generation efforts.
Ensure field marketing programs have clear objectives, target audiences, measurement plans, and connections to commercial outcomes.


About You


Bachelors Degree in Marketing or related
10+ years of marketing experience, with a strong background in regional, field, integrated, or growth marketing within a global or multi-market organization.
Demonstrated experience translating global marketing strategies into effective regional and local execution, balancing consistency with local market needs.
Strong understanding of marketing performance and measurement, with the ability to identify business drivers, interpret data, and translate insights into actionable recommendations.
Strong commercial orientation, with an understanding of how marketing contributes to demand, pipeline, occupancy, revenue, and other business outcomes.
Experience with property, location-based, retail, hospitality, real estate, or other distributed/physical-location marketing strongly preferred.
Exceptional cross-functional and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively across geographies, functions, and levels of seniority.
Strategic and solutions-oriented thinker who is equally comfortable being hands-on and driving execution in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information and clearly communicate recommendations to senior stakeholders.
Given the global nature of the role, flexibility to work across a variety of time zones and occasionally outside of standard local business hours is required.
Fluency in English required; Spanish and/or Portuguese fluency strongly preferred.


Life at WeWork

Being a WeWorker is more than just a job. We believe the magic of work is sparked by the passion you bring, the places you go, the people you meet and the purpose you follow. And it starts here. Here you will brush shoulders with those who dare to dream and do. Here you will be welcomed by a community that embraces and inspires you—because together we can achieve more. Here we challenge ideas, and explore new ways of getting things done. Whether you are part of our Employee Community Groups, or part of a global project, we ask you to bring your open-minded attitude and collaborative spirit. In return, you will be part of a team where your unique perspectives are celebrated.

description:
About the job

This role oversees the lifecycle of forward-deployed engineering engagements in which MongoDB Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) partner closely with customer engineering teams to build working agents.

It is a high-impact role at the intersection of customer delivery, AI agent development, and product feedback. By working closely with customers during implementation, the Sr. Technical Program Manager helps shape real-world agent outcomes, demonstrate the value of MongoDB’s platform in live enterprise environments, and bring back insights that can inform future product direction.

These engagements are designed to help customers realize business value from our platform, accelerate successful agent delivery, and generate product feedback through close collaboration during implementation.

The Sr. Technical Program Manager, FDE Engagements drives successful delivery by aligning stakeholders, managing risks and dependencies, removing operational blockers, and ensuring clear ownership, communication, and decision-making across the engagement lifecycle. In partnership with FDE, Product, Engineering, account teams, and customer stakeholders, this role is accountable for program execution and engagement outcomes.

If an action item does not yet have an explicitly assigned owner, the Sr. Technical Program Manager is responsible for driving assignment and follow-through until ownership is clear.

Pre-customer environment access

Main goals:


Secure access to the customer's internal collaboration and development tooling as early as possible
Align on the intended behavior, functionality, and architecture of the agents
Define how the FDE team and customer engineering team will collaborate on use case and architecture definition, code, and execution
Establish the deployment path for MongoDB’s tools across customer development and cloud environments
Confirm business goals, technical scope, and success criteria for the engagement


During this phase, the Sr. Technical Program Manager partners with the assigned FDE team, account teams, and customer stakeholders to coordinate onboarding requirements, dependency management, planning, and readiness activities. This may include coordinating statements of work, contractor onboarding steps, access approvals, and early execution planning.

The pre-access period should also be used to build a shared understanding of the business value, intended behavior, and technical architecture of the agent. The team should prepare the technical design inputs needed to break the work into executable tasks in the customer's preferred engineering collaboration environment.

Deliverables:


Engagement overview deck
Agent technical spec
Agent architecture
Mutually agreed-upon definition of success 


Agent build and prototyping

Main goals


Enable the joint engineering team to develop agents locally and contribute to a shared code repository
Establish a viable path to deployment in MongoDB’s production environment
Support a single-team execution model across MongoDB and customer engineers
Provide structured status updates and feedback loops to internal product stakeholders


During this phase, the team should adapt to the customer’s preferred engineering collaboration model where it supports execution. FDEs may lead or contribute to technical workstreams, while the Sr. Technical Program Manager drives coordination, planning, risk management, communication, escalation and execution tracking across the engagement.

FDEs kick off this phase by running an onboarding session for the customer engineering team to ensure that local development setup is seamless. FDEs should then act as a leader or member of their engineering team to break out the work in the agents’ technical spec into tickets that are picked up by both the FDE and customer’s engineers.

One particular item to look out for are red tape and restrictions around cloud deployments. Since our customers are often regulated industries, we might need to work with VDIs and artifact repositories instead of our native Github tooling. It should be a priority to determine the path to deploying the agents once code complete.

Deliverables


Customer onboarding session
Engagement status updates and feedback to the Product team about issues or unmet needs
Working agent deployed onto the product, integrated into the customer’s cloud infrastructure


Readout and closeout of engagement

Main goals


Confirm long-term ownership of the agent
Ensure the customer has a roadmap for continued usage and development
Identify opportunities for future paid FDE engagement support where appropriate


Once the agent fulfills the initial engagement requirements, the team should prepare an engagement readout that demonstrates what was built, what business value was created, and what path exists for continued investment and adoption.

By the end of this phase, the customer should be positioned to continue development of the agent independently and to provide ongoing product feedback to MongoDB. Where appropriate, MongoDB may continue to support the customer through additional phases of the project.

Deliverables


Engagement readout deck
MongoDB-internal perspective on future FDE engagement opportunities


Qualifications


5+ years of experience leading complex technical programs or engineering initiatives from initiation through delivery, including planning, execution, and cross-functional coordination in customer-facing enterprise software, platform, infrastructure, or applied AI environments. 
Working fluency in modern AI application architectures, including LLM-based workflows, retrieval and grounding patterns, orchestration frameworks, and evaluation approaches, with the ability to partner credibly with technical teams and scope technical tradeoffs
Demonstrated success operating in ambiguous, fast-changing technical environments and driving programs forward through structured planning, proactive dependency management, and clear decision-making
Strong ability to partner across Engineering, Product, customer stakeholders, and delivery teams to align goals, scope, priorities, timelines, and execution across the full engagement lifecycle, from onboarding and access planning through technical design, deployment, executive readouts, and transition to long-term ownership
Fluency in English, spoken and written
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce clear documentation, maintain durable decision records, tailor communication to technical, executive, and customer audiences, and connect technical delivery decisions to customer business value, adoption, and long-term growth opportunities


Preferred Qualifications:


Experience in forward-deployed, embedded, or other high-touch customer delivery models
Experience working with regulated or operationally constrained customer environments, including enterprise access controls, non-standard development tooling, artifact repositories, and deployment governance

MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

You Are

This is a high-impact opportunity to directly influence future server SOC and platform designs.

 As a SystemC Modeling Developer, you will be responsible, but not limited to:

 Work with simulators such as Synopsys Virtualizer, Cadence VSP, QEMU-based frameworks, etc.

 Document model features, APIs, interfaces, and usage workflows for internal teams.

 Bachelor´s or Master´s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.

 Computer architecture including CPU pipelines, cache hierarchy, memory controllers, PCIe/CXL, and AI/compute subsystems.
 Pre-silicon simulation, or architectural modeling for semiconductor/server platforms.
 Cycle-accurate, timing-accurate, or transaction-level modeling.

 Performance data, interpret system behavior, and provide optimization insights.

 Experience with performance tools, trace-driven analysis, or workload modeling.

About the job

Role Title: Vlogger (Insta360, DJI Osmo, GoPro MAX)




Role Type: Contractor




Location: Remote




micro1 is engaging 360° Video Recorders (Insta360 / GoPro MAX) to contribute to a customer's project by capturing immersive, high-quality footage with leading 360° camera equipment. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform.




We are looking for individuals to collect third-person video across several real-world capture types, including movement through changing environments, vehicle navigation, and animal-mounted POV recordings. Recordings should focus on continuous movement, changing scenery, and natural navigation through the environment.




Scope of Work

Capture a diverse set of continuous video clips (minimum 60 seconds each) of everyday activities in a range of environments, including indoor, outdoor, and in-vehicle settings.
Consistently utilize compatible 360° or wide-angle cameras (e.g., Insta360, DJI Osmo, GoPro MAX series) with at least 170° FOV and 720p resolution, ensuring stable, third-person perspective according to project standards.
Implement appropriate mounting solutions, such as backpack or vehicle mounts, to maintain a clear third-person view where your entire body and surroundings are visible throughout each activity.
Follow provided guidelines and instructions for camera placement, activity selection, and safety to ensure data consistency and collection integrity.
Document, organize, and submit video files in accordance with project specifications, ensuring all deliverables meet technical and quality requirements.
Communicate proactively and clearly in both written and verbal form regarding progress, questions, and any technical challenges.
Adapt to occasional updates in collection tasks, environments, or technical requirements as defined by project needs.




Compatible camera examples include:

Insta360 X3, X4, X5, X6
DJI Osmo 360
GoPro MAX, MAX2
Other action or 360° cameras that meet the minimum 170° FOV and 720p requirements




Examples of compatible third-person mounting rigs include:

Insta360 Third-Person Backpack Mount and other harness-mounted extension systems.
Owning a compatible backpack or vehicle mount is a plus and may let you start collecting sooner.




Third-Person Camera Setup

Mounted above and behind you
Angled slightly downward
Positioned far enough back to keep your entire body consistently visible
Stable enough to maintain the required third-person perspective during normal movement




If using a camera with less than 360° FOV, the mounting setup must position the camera far enough away to keep your entire body in frame while also capturing the surrounding environment. Your full body should remain visible throughout normal movement without frequently leaving the frame.




Handheld selfie sticks, chest mounts, shoulder clips, and stationary tripods do not meet the required third-person perspective.




Expected Recording Tasks may include:

Natural everyday activities
Indoor and outdoor activities
Walking and moving through different environments
Vehicle navigation and driving-related recordings
Other similar real-world activities provided in the collection instructions




For vehicle navigation tasks, the camera must be securely mounted to the vehicle.




Recording Requirements

Capture a variety of activities and environments

Follow the required camera position for each assigned task

description:
About the job

At F5, we strive to bring a better digital world to life. Our teams empower organizations across the globe to create, secure, and run applications that enhance how we experience our evolving digital world. We are passionate about cybersecurity, from protecting consumers from fraud to enabling companies to focus on innovation.

Everything we do centers around people. That means we obsess over how to make the lives of our customers, and their customers, better. And it means we prioritize a diverse F5 community where each individual can thrive.

The Sr Solutions Engineer (SE) is a sales and technical role, part of a sales team, working with F5 end-user customers and partners. The high-level objective is, together with a Named Account Manager, achieve the allocated sales target by selling F5’s solutions to a pre-defined number of end-user accounts. Critical to the success is the SE’s ability to work with end-users and F5 channel partners, to drive F5 solution sales, doing demonstrations, Proof of Concept tests (hands-on) that allow successful implementation of F5 technologies at those selected accounts.

The SE primary responsibility is to develop and deliver the sales team’s technical strategy, ensuring that the best matching and business effective F5 solutions are driven to her/his customers.

In customer engagements, the F5 SE should always engage customers with a Consultative Sales approach. This approach requires that the SE works to proactively learn and fully understand existing business and technical solutions and identify key “pain points”, challenges, and, most importantly, the gains achieved by implementing a F5 solution. You are able to discuss both technical and business benefits and not just technical features, establishing a value relationship and become the trusted advisor to your customers.

Collaboration is key to success, hence you should jointly, together with your team’s F5 salesperson, fully understand and drive the sales process, which should include identifying the Technical Decision Maker (TDM) and getting technical validation, support, and sponsorship from the TDM. And, as we always sell through our channel partners, the proposed solutions should be jointly defined with the partner sales team’s close participation so that together we can build business value propositions which address and solve real customer’s needs.

In terms of knowledge, the SE needs to have solid technical skills on F5 key solutions’ use-cases and the broader ecosystem that we work with. But, while the SE is encouraged to be able to balance requests around the whole set of F5 solutions, we expect that she/he works towards building deeper expertise only in a very reduced set of use-cases (Prime Solution), becoming the regional expert for the chosen use-cases, supporting other SEs just like she/he will also be supported by other experts in other key use-cases. Strong technical skills are a prerequisite and should continuously be improved as F5 provides training and certification opportunities.

Understand the needs and objectives of our customers, and then design a technical solution which can build a new customer service or solve customer business problems

title: The New Model Program - Ford Champ
description:
About the job

Description: Main purpose of the role, a general summary of what is done in this area. The main function of the New Programs area is to implement the new production models included in Ford Motor Co.'s Business Plan. One of the main activities expected for this position is to exercise leadership among cross-functional teams, to ensure that the activities established in the Launch system standards are met on time and as planned. The basic tools to be used are those included in GPDS and LQOS (which represent the standards and operating systems for the Launch of new programs).

The breakdown of key activities and specific functions this position will be responsible for. The main activities of this position include the daily documentation of the main metrics for the current program (CX430/P758 27MY, 27.5MY &28MY Launch). Every day, the Launch group meets to review metrics, key issues, work plans, and support required by each area. This person's role is to facilitate the meeting so that the group has a clear understanding of the program's health.

A second function will be to prepare, in Excel and with the help of the Parts system (OTG), the daily status of the parts changing in this Launch. This report includes the evolution and progress of production parts until they reach "Saleable" status (Phase 2 PPAP).

It is also expected that, when the parts to be assembled in pre-production events arrive at the Plant, they will be certified by the Engineers who release and design these parts. A third function will be to coordinate this activity and report on it to the Launch group.

Likewise, this person will help coordinate quality review activities for finished Pre-production products. This includes FCPA audits, Campaign prevention, and R202 Management (Quality Plan), as well as reporting results and documenting any issues found. Additionally, this person will lead the documentation required to ship these units to Ford's internal customers.

The technical skills and knowledge necessary to fill this position. We are looking for someone with an Engineering degree. Proficiency in the Microsoft Office suite — Excel, Word, PowerPoint — and general computer skills is required, as Ford's information systems require this ability. We are looking for someone who can demonstrate strong communication skills, teamwork, and the ability to express themselves in English. The candidate should be a quick learner of operating systems and data management tools. Examples: Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Systems Engineering, etc.

This allows them to reach and engage customers on their preferred schedule and channel — including voice, video, and messaging. Think of a rideshare service instantly connecting with customers, hospital staff conducting remote monitoring, customers verifying their identity before completing a purchase, AI virtual agents servicing customers around the clock, and much more.

Why this role matters:

Our Customer Success Training Specialist will provide the foundational learning for our Customer Success teams. In this role you will be the architect of the CS journey, from the moment a new CSM joins to the mastery of our post-sales ecosystem.

End-to-End Onboarding: Design and lead a world-class onboarding program that gets new CSMs up to speed on our product, our customers, and our unique approach to partnership.

To be successful in this role, you should be a blend of an educator, a strategist, and a Customer Success advocate. We are looking for someone who understands that CS is both an art and a science.

CS Enablement Background: 2–4 years of experience in Customer Success training and enablement. If you’ve previously carried a book of business as a CSM, that’s a major plus.

Strategic Advisor: A champion for continuous improvement who isn't afraid to identify skill gaps and propose creative solutions to fill them.
Methodology Knowledge: A background in MEDDPICC or similar sales/success methodologies is a significant advantage.
Where you will work:

This position offers a fully remote work arrangement based out of Mexico.

Sponsorship is not available. Legal authorization to work in Mexico is required. We are unable to sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening. 

 

There’s no perfect candidate. You don't need all the preferred qualifications to make a valuable impact on our team. Our employees and customers come from diverse backgrounds, so if you're passionate about what you could achieve at Vonage, we'd love to hear from you.

To learn how we process your personal data during the recruitment process, please refer to our Privacy Notice.

Vonage is a global cloud communications leader. description:
About the job

As the largest pureplay adhesives company in the world, H.B. Fuller’s (NYSE: FUL) innovative, functional coatings, adhesives and sealants enhance the quality, safety and performance of products people use every day. Founded in 1887, with 2025 revenue of $3.5 billion, our mission to Connect What Matters is brought to life by more than 7,100 global team members who collaborate with customers across more than 30 market segments in 150 countries to develop highly specified solutions that enable customers to bring world-changing innovations to their end markets. Learn more at www.hbfuller.com.

Position Title: Quality Coordinator

Location: Piedras Negras, Coahuila

Shift: Flexible Shift Options (Weekend Shift or 4x4 Shift)

Position Overview

This position is responsible for maintaining quality assurance continuity and laboratory oversight during operational shifts at the Piedras Negras plant. The Quality Coordinator executes standard laboratory testing, process audits, and system transactions to verify that all adhesive batches meet H.B. Fuller’s corporate specifications.

Primary Responsibilities


Execute standard physical and chemical laboratory testing on raw materials, in-process goods, and finished adhesive products.
Disposition and authorize the quality release of manufacturing batches based on established corporate specifications.
Identify, segregate, and document any non-conforming materials or process deviations encountered during the shift.
Log all inspection records and test results accurately into the plant’s internal Quality Management System (QMS) to ensure full traceability.
Utilize SAP to perform quality inventory movements, block/unblock materials, and enter inspection lot data.
Conduct regular quality audits and line clearance checks directly on the production and packaging floors.
Perform basic verification, calibration checks, and routine housekeeping (5S) of laboratory equipment and instruments.
Enforce strict compliance with all corporate EHS policies, safety guidelines, and the mandatory use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).
Document and escalate critical quality incidents to the Quality Manager, providing a comprehensive shift-handover report for the incoming team.



Minimum Requirements


Active student in the final year or recent graduate of a Technical Degree or Bachelor’s Program in Engineering (Chemical, Industrial, Materials, or related technical field).
Availability to work flexible rotating shift schedules, which may include weekend coverage or a 4x4 shift structure.
Permanent or current residence in Piedras Negras, Coahuila, with reliable transportation to the plant site.
Basic proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel) for data entry, report generation, and metric tracking.
Strong capability to comprehend and follow written technical procedures, Material Safety Data Sheets (MSDS), and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
High level of autonomy, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills to manage laboratory operations with minimal supervision during off-shifts.



Preferred Requirements


Prior experience or basic exposure to SAP (QM module) or any other Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) software.
Previous exposure to industrial manufacturing environments through school laboratory projects, internships, or technical residencies.
Conceptual understanding of Quality Management Systems standards (such as ISO 9001) and continuous improvement tools (5S, Lean).
Basic ability to interpret technical data sheets, certificate of analysis (COA) documents, and process flowcharts.
Basic knowledge of chemical handling, chemical safety regulations, or polymers/adhesives characteristics.

description:
About the job

Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide! Vonage Communications APIs:

As an emerging leader in the $10B+ communications API market, we empower global brands to connect better with their customers, employees, and partners through transformative communications experiences. For example, Vonage API solutions empower organizations to build their custom omnichannel communications structure. This allows them to reach and engage customers on their preferred schedule and channel — including voice, video, and messaging. Think of a rideshare service instantly connecting with customers, hospital staff conducting remote monitoring, customers verifying their identity before completing a purchase, AI virtual agents servicing customers around the clock, and much more.

Why this role matters:

Our Customer Success Training Specialist will provide the foundational learning for our Customer Success teams. In this role you will be the architect of the CS journey, from the moment a new CSM joins to the mastery of our post-sales ecosystem.

Your key responsibilities:
End-to-End Onboarding: Design and lead a world-class onboarding program that gets new CSMs up to speed on our product, our customers, and our unique approach to partnership.
Continuous Enablement: Develop post-onboarding curricula that keep the team sharp on new feature releases, industry trends, and advanced account management strategies ; including expansion positioning from upselling and cross-selling 
Needs Assessment: Identify knowledge and skill gaps through data-driven assessments, aligning all training programs to revenue priorities and business objectives.
Blended Learning Delivery: Develop and deliver engaging learning experiences—including live workshops, virtual sessions, and eLearning—for global CS teams of all experience levels.
Tactical Content Creation: Build practical exercises, job aids, and visual guides that translate technical API capabilities and product updates into actionable "Success Plays."
Tools & Stack Mastery: Serve as the subject matter expert for the CS toolset (Gong, Salesforce andPlanhat,ensuring the team navigates our systems with speed and precision.
Strategic Partnership: Collaborate with CS Leadership to drive accountability and partner with Sales Enablement to ensure cohesive product and process updates across the revenue org.
Advocacy & Improvement: Serve as a trusted advisor and champion for continuous improvement in CS skills, processes, and training best practices.

 

What you’ll bring:

To be successful in this role, you should be a blend of an educator, a strategist, and a Customer Success advocate. We are looking for someone who understands that CS is both an art and a science. 

Required:

CS Enablement Background: 2–4 years of experience in Customer Success training and enablement. If you’ve previously carried a book of business as a CSM, that’s a major plus.
The "CS Lens" on Sales Process: A solid understanding of the B2B lifecycle. You understand how discovery, handoffs, and pipeline management directly impact long-term retention and expansion.
CS Tech Stack Power User: High proficiency in Salesforce and Planhat (or similar CS Platform such as Gainsight, Totango, Hubspot, Zendesk, and Churn Zero etc.). You are comfortable being the "go-to" expert who helps others navigate our tools with speed and precision.
Instructional Design Mastery: Experience creating clean, professional training materials, slide decks, and tutorials. Proficiency in Articulate (or similar authoring tools) is required to build our eLearning library.
Strong Facilitation Skills: You are a confident, engaging presenter who can break down complex API capabilities or process-heavy workflows into simple, actionable steps.

Experience we consider a plus:

Cross-Functional Collaborator: Ability to work effectively with Sales/CS Ops, Product Marketing, and CS Managers to ensure content is technically accurate and relevant to the field.
Detail-Oriented & Precise: A passion for accuracy and a "get it right" mindset when documenting internal processes and system workflows.
Strategic Advisor: A champion for continuous improvement who isn't afraid to identify skill gaps and propose creative solutions to fill them.
Methodology Knowledge: A background in MEDDPICC or similar sales/success methodologies is a significant advantage.
Where you will work:

This position offers a fully remote work arrangement based out of Mexico.

Sponsorship is not available. Legal authorization to work in Mexico is required. We are unable to sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening. 

 

There’s no perfect candidate. You don't need all the preferred qualifications to make a valuable impact on our team. Our employees and customers come from diverse backgrounds, so if you're passionate about what you could achieve at Vonage, we'd love to hear from you.

To learn how we process your personal data during the recruitment process, please refer to our Privacy Notice. 

Who we are:

Vonage is a global cloud communications leader. And your talent will further help brands - such as Airbnb, Viber, WhatsApp, and Snapchat - accelerate their digital transformation through our fully programmable-based unified communications, contact center solutions, and communications APIs. Ready to innovate? Then join us today.

Note: The purpose of this profile is to provide a general summary of essential responsibilities for the position and is not meant as an exhaustive list. Assignments may differ for individuals within the same role based on business conditions, departmental need or geographic location.

About the job

Description

At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people.

Amazon is seeking Shift Station Manager with the chance to be based in Hermosillo, Sonora, MX. Amazon is one of the most recognizable brand names in the world and we distribute millions of products each year to our loyal customers.

Three Key Areas That You Will Always Focus On Are Safety, Service Quality, Customer Experience, And Productivity Of Your Department. Main Activities Are


 Review the operational forecast and determine productivity requirements for sort operation, manage a team group to meet all building’s goals.
 Support all safety programs to ensure a safe work environment for all associates and Delivery service providers.
 Proactively identify and lead process improvement initiatives and Lean tools.


Supervisory Responsibilities

You will be part of the Amazon Logistics Team, responsible of the day-to-day management of the delivery station, overseeing the operation that focuses on the delivery of Amazon orders direct to customers.

Leading a team of Process Assistants and Delivery Service Providers in daily management of the delivery station, including meetings, training sessions, assigning job duties, and communicating with DSPs including management representatives and their drivers.

You are responsible for ensuring that you have a safe work place, properly trained people, and that their needs are addressed so they can focus on their jobs.

In addition, one of the most important aspects of your job is to lead change at internet speed… innovation has made us the global company that we are today.

Help in daily operations: Receive, scan, lift and move shipments up to 25 kgs. Each

Route shipments within the AMZL coverage area.

Support and assign job duties to process assistants.

Due to the nature of Amazon’s business, being able to adapt to sudden changes and growth according to operational necessities.

Track & monitor sorting operation and driver’s dispatch.

Continual standing and/or walking an average of 5 miles daily.

Ability to work in construction /distribution environments that may be noisy, unlit, unheated, not air-conditioned.

#AmazonMexico

 Bachelor's degree or equivalent
 2+ years of employee and performance management experience
 2+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience
 Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
